explain_en: A column named customer_id usually points to the id of a customers (or customer) table.
explain_hi: customer_id jaisa column aam taur pe customers (ya customer) table ki id ki taraf ishara karta hai.

explain_en: A date kept as text can't be sorted or filtered by date properly and can't use date functions; use DATE/DATETIME/TIMESTAMP.
explain_hi: Date ko text mein rakhne se sahi sorting/filtering nahi hoti aur date functions kaam nahi karte; DATE/DATETIME/TIMESTAMP use karo.
